argv:
root=/Volumes/KINGSTON/AIVERSE-builds/caverns-stage59
linux="$root/stage30-linux"
compiler="$linux/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-g++"
"$compiler" --version
"$compiler" -std=c++20 -Werror=class-memaccess -I. -Iengine -Ilibraries/include -c engine/fx/SpectraGpuParticles.cpp -o "$linux/SpectraGpuParticles.o"
file "$linux/SpectraGpuParticles.o"
build="$root/0f4394d81d798f28bfdf6b5e43991057a9e7636b"
test "$(git -C /private/tmp/aiverse-building-caverns-integration rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
cmake --build "$build" --target aiverse_spectrafx_metal_allocator_test -j 6
ctest --test-dir "$build" --no-tests=error -V -R "^spectrafx_metal_allocator$" > "$root/stage30-metal-test.log"
cat "$root/stage30-metal-test.log"
rg -q "PASS owned checkpoint procedural=0" "$root/stage30-metal-test.log"
rg -q "PASS owned checkpoint procedural=1" "$root/stage30-metal-test.log"
